description: Source file implementing the TouchedWindow class, managing hover and touch pointers within the Android input dispatcher system.

classes.name: TouchedWindow
classes.description: Class managing touch and hover pointer states for a window in Android input system.

methods.description: Checks if there are any hovering pointers.

methods.description: Checks if there are hovering pointers for a specific device ID.

methods.description: Adds a hovering pointer for a device and pointer ID.

methods.description: Removes a touching pointer by pointer ID.

methods.name: removeHoveringPointer

methods.name: removeAllHoveringPointersForDevice
